theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_interior_product_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ζ : MultiVector P (n + 1)) (ζ' : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ζ Q → ν ∈ Q → ‖ν‖ = 1 → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ζ' α = ζ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ ν).smulRight α))) → IsUnitOrientationOf ζ' (Q ⊓ (ℝ ∙ ν)ᗮ)
